dct_description_sm: This map shows the City’s Natural Heritage Features and Areas, including Valleylands/Watercourse Corridors, Woodlands, Lakes and Ponds, and Wetlands, along with Policy based areas such as Provincially Significant Wetlands, Special Policy Areas, Environmentally Sensitive/Significant Areas, Provincial Greenbelt/Protected Countryside, Areas of Natural and Scientific Interest.
dct_title_s: Official Plan Schedule D Natural Heritage Features and Areas
